methodology: Financials use USD billions, with CAD billions for Cameco. Net income is attributable to common shareholders, equity holders or company owners as reported. Debt is outstanding borrowing at period end, before cash. Quarterly operating cash flow or capex comes from quarterly issuer reporting or subtracts the six-month total from the nine-month total. Illustrative free cash flow equals operating cash flow less disclosed cash capital expenditures. Issuer-defined adjusted free cash flow may differ. Growth compares like periods. A zero revenue denominator makes growth and margins unavailable. Valuation scenarios use analyst assumptions and produce illustrative USD share prices.

topics.body: The IEA projects almost twice as much data center electricity use in 2030 as in 2025 and roughly a tripling for AI-focused facilities over the same period. Large campuses can strain a specific substation long before the sector becomes a major share of national or global demand.

topics.title: Nuclear power
topics.body: Reactors supply reliable low-emissions power with high utilization. Keeping an operating plant licensed, uprating output and restarting a closed plant carry different costs and schedules from building a new reactor.

topics.body: Gas plants can dispatch power when demand rises or other generation is scarce. Delivered fuel prices depend on pipeline capacity, weather and regional gas prices. Building a plant also requires a turbine, a fuel connection and permits.

topics.body: A mine produces uranium concentrate. Conversion, enrichment for many reactor designs, and fabrication turn that material into reactor fuel. Geological concentration and service capacity can constrain supply at different points.

topics.title: Renewables and storage
topics.body: Wind and solar output follows weather, sunlight and siting conditions. Storage can shift energy across hours. The combination’s ability to serve prolonged peaks depends on stored energy, grid connections and complementary resources.

topics.body: Transmission moves bulk power and distribution delivers it to customers. Interconnection studies, transformers, switchgear and transmission buildouts affect how quickly new generation and load can connect.
